components.css: .ds-bike-card{width:min(420px,100%);border:1px solid #323236;background:#0d0d0f;color:#f8f8f5;font-family:var(--body,Manrope,Arial,sans-serif);transition:background .25s ease}.ds-bike-card:hover{background:#151518}.ds-bike-image{height:210px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#2a2a2e,#101012 55%,#0d0d0f)}.ds-bike-index,.ds-bike-type,.ds-image-note{position:absolute;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-bike-index{top:16px;left:16px;color:#aaa;font:600 12px/1 var(--display,'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif)}.ds-bike-type{top:14px;right:14px;padding:5px 8px;background:rgba(9,9,10,.82);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em}.ds-image-note{left:16px;bottom:10px;color:#d0d0d2;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.08em}.ds-bike-info{padding:18px 20px 22px}.ds-bike-title-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}.ds-bike-title-row h3{margin:0;font:600 26px/1 var(--display,'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif);text-transform:uppercase}.ds-bike-price{text-align:right;color:var(--red-bright,#ff6575);font:700 22px/1 var(--display,'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif)}.ds-bike-price small{display:block;color:#888;font:500 10px/1.5 var(--body,Manrope,sans-serif)}.ds-bike-specs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;margin:20px 0;border-top:1px solid #2d2d31;padding-top:16px}.ds-bike-specs span{color:#8d8d91;font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-bike-specs b{display:block;margin-top:3px;color:#eee;font-size:12px;text-transform:none}.ds-bike-action{width:100%;min-height:44px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;border:1px solid #45454a;background:transparent;color:#fff;padding:10px 13px;font-weight:700}.ds-bike-action:hover{background:#fff;color:#111;border-color:#fff}.ds-bike-action:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #fff;outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview:
Rastro Motos transforma a página em uma sequência de trechos: campos de asfalto quase preto, intervalos de papel técnico e vermelho pista conduzem o visitante da promessa de liberdade até a comparação objetiva e o contato. A atmosfera é sofisticada e mecânica sem virar decoração temática; motos, números, especificações e decisões continuam no primeiro plano.

A assinatura nasce da continuidade dos marcos quilométricos, da linguagem de rota, das linhas técnicas e dos filtros que tornam o catálogo navegável como um roadbook. A experiência permanece honesta: preços, frota, endereço e imagens de categoria são explicitamente demonstrativos.
keyCharacteristics: Contraste cinematográfico entre asfalto, papel técnico e vermelho pista.
Tipografia condensada, maiúscula e monumental para voz editorial; sans humanista para leitura e ação.
Composição modular, linhas finas e cantos retos inspirados em placas e fichas de percurso.
Marcos KM e vocabulário de rota conectando as seções sem ornamento persistente na viewport.
Catálogo comparável, filtrável e progressivo no celular, com verdade visual explícita sobre as imagens.

rules.name: The Route Continuity Rule
rules.body: Preserve the sequence through KM markers, route language, section contrast, and navigable filters.

rules.name: The Red Field Rule
rules.body: Use rally red for decisive states and occasional full-width fields; never scatter it as decoration across every component.

rules.name: The Technical Paper Rule
rules.body: Light sections use the cool roadbook mist so the page feels printed and mechanical rather than sterile.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Barlow Condensed announces route, speed, and hierarchy; Manrope explains, compares, and enables action. Do not swap their jobs.

rules.name: The Progressive Catalog Rule
rules.body: On mobile, show six cards only for the untouched all-motorcycles state; filters and search must always reveal their complete matching set.

rules.name: The Fixed Action Rule
rules.body: The mobile navigation must carry its own full-width WhatsApp action because the desktop header action is hidden below 980px; the floating contact remains a secondary persistent route.

rules.name: The Flat Machinery Rule
rules.body: Use borders and tonal steps for ordinary hierarchy; reserve ambient shadow for persistent floating utility.

rules.name: The Signal Circle Rule
rules.body: Circles indicate availability, direct contact, or route resonance; never round every container to make the interface friendlier.

dos: Do preserve KM markers, route language, and catalog controls as the recurring roadbook signature.
Do label catalog artwork as category imagery and state that it does not represent the named motorcycle.
Do keep price, availability, address, hours, and operational claims visibly demonstrative until real data replaces them.
Do keep specifications and price visible without hover, and retain the progressive six-card mobile catalog only in the untouched state.
Do provide the WhatsApp action inside the open mobile navigation as well as the floating shortcut.
Do preserve visible focus and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't turn the catalog into detached rounded cards with diffuse shadows.
Don't use red on every surface; it must retain the force of an active state or route decision.
Don't use category artwork as if it were a verified photograph of a specific motorcycle model.
Don't hide filtered or searched mobile results behind the initial six-card progressive limit.
Don't remove the mobile-menu WhatsApp row when the desktop header action collapses.
